Every system, every scale

Tabletop Game Scale Guide

Every tabletop game scales its minis differently, and figuring out the right slicer percentage for your army should not take hours of searching. Pick a game below to open its full 3D-printing scale guide — the exact slicer percentage, printing settings, and conversion data for scaling those STL files on your FDM printer.

6mm Scale

1 system

BattleTech

Catalyst Game Labs
1:285

BattleTech is a tactical wargame where players control giant robotic war machines called BattleMechs. Miniatures are 6mm scale (approximately 1:285), with 'mechs ranging from 30mm to 55mm tall depending on weight class. The game uses hex-movement rather than measuring tapes.

Sci-fi Tactical Wargame · 6mm
2 conversions

8mm Scale

1 system

Legions Imperialis

Games Workshop
1:200

Legions Imperialis is Games Workshop's return to epic-scale warfare, covering the Horus Heresy with hundreds of miniatures on a single table. At 8mm, individual Space Marines are tiny but recognizable, and Titans loom over entire formations.

Epic-Scale Sci-fi Wargame · 8mm
2 conversions

10mm Scale

1 system

Dropzone Commander

TTCombat
1:160

Dropzone Commander is a 10mm sci-fi wargame depicting massive 27th-century battles with infantry, tanks, and dropships. The small scale allows entire companies with transport vehicles to be fielded in a single game, emphasizing combined-arms tactics over individual heroics.

Sci-fi Mass Battle Wargame · 10mm
2 conversions

15mm Scale

1 system

Flames of War

Battlefront Miniatures
1:100

Flames of War is one of the most widely played 15mm WWII wargames, covering company-level engagements across all major theaters. Miniatures are 1:100 scale, allowing entire companies with supporting armor to fit on a standard gaming table. Team Yankee extends the system to Cold War-era conflicts.

Historical Wargame (WWII) · 15mm
4 conversions

28mm Scale

7 systems

Warhammer: The Old World

Games Workshop
1:56

The Old World revives the classic Warhammer Fantasy setting with ranked regiments, tile-based movement, and the Old World map. It uses the legacy 28mm fantasy scale, making it compatible with decades of classic Citadel miniatures alongside new releases.

Classic Fantasy Wargame · 28mm
4 conversions

Middle-earth Strategy Battle Game

Games Workshop
1:56

Based on The Lord of the Rings and The Hobbit films, MESBG is a skirmish-focused wargame where individual heroes matter as much as armies. The range spans from 25mm (older metal sculpts from the early 2000s) to modern 28mm plastic kits, all designed to match the film actors' proportions.

Fantasy Skirmish Wargame · 28mm
4 conversions

Bolt Action

Warlord Games
1:56

Bolt Action is one of the most widely played WWII tabletop wargames, covering platoon-level engagements from 1939-1945. Infantry are 28mm true scale (1:56), and vehicle kits from Warlord and other manufacturers follow the same ratio, making 1:35 model kit vehicles usable after slight downsizing.

Historical Wargame (WWII) · 28mm
4 conversions

Dungeons & Dragons

Wizards of the Coast
1:56

Dungeons & Dragons is the original tabletop roleplaying game — players create characters and go on collaborative storytelling adventures. Miniatures are optional but widely used for combat encounters, with a Medium creature (human-sized) typically measuring 28mm to eye level on a 175cm baseline.

Tabletop RPG · 28mm
4 conversions

Infinity

Corvus Belli
1:56

Infinity is a Japanese-anime-influenced sci-fi skirmish game set in a far-future human sphere. Corvus Belli's metal miniatures are renowned for their dynamic poses and intricate detail, with slimmer proportions than heroic-scale games despite the 28mm designation.

Sci-fi Skirmish Wargame · 28mm
4 conversions

Frostgrave & Stargrave

Osprey Games / Warlord Games
1:56

Frostgrave is a fantasy skirmish game about wizards exploring a frozen ruined city, while Stargrave applies the same system to a sci-fi setting. Both are miniature-agnostic — you can use any 28mm fantasy or sci-fi miniatures, making them ideal for 3D printing custom warbands.

Fantasy/Sci-fi Skirmish Wargame · 28mm
4 conversions

Kings of War

Mantic Games
1:56

Kings of War is Mantic Games' rank-and-flank fantasy wargame, designed as an alternative to Warhammer Fantasy with streamlined rules and regiment-based play. The entire range is 28mm scale, and the game actively encourages using miniatures from any fantasy range.

Fantasy Mass Battle Wargame · 28mm
4 conversions

30mm Scale

1 system

Warmachine & Hordes

Privateer Press
1:54

Warmachine and its companion game Hordes — steam-powered warjacks and magical beasts clashing in a fantasy world of industrial warfare. Originally labelled 28mm, Privateer Press shifted to calling the scale 30mm as the range evolved through scale creep.

Steampunk Fantasy Wargame · 30mm
4 conversions

32mm Scale

8 systems

Warhammer 40,000

Games Workshop
1:50

Warhammer 40,000 is the biggest sci-fi tabletop wargame out there — Space Marines, Chaos forces, Orks, Eldar, and dozens of other factions fighting it out in the 41st millennium. Modern kits since 2017 (Primaris range) sit squarely at 32mm heroic scale, while older Firstborn models measure closer to 28mm true scale.

Sci-fi Wargame · 32mm
4 conversions

Warhammer Age of Sigmar

Games Workshop
1:50

Age of Sigmar replaced Warhammer Fantasy Battle in 2015, shifting from ranked infantry blocks to hero-focused skirmish and mass battle in a high-fantasy setting. The miniature scale matches modern Warhammer 40k — all new GW fantasy releases since 2015 are 32mm heroic.

Fantasy Wargame · 32mm
4 conversions

Malifaux

Wyrd Miniatures
1:50

Malifaux is a card-driven skirmish game set in a gothic steampunk alternate Earth where magic and technology collide. Miniatures are 32mm heroic scale, produced in high-quality plastic since the 4th Edition relaunch, with a distinctive artistic style that blends horror, western, and Victorian aesthetics.

Gothic Pulp Skirmish Wargame · 32mm
4 conversions

Grimdark Future (One Page Rules)

One Page Rules
1:50

Grimdark Future is One Page Rules' free, miniature-agnostic sci-fi wargame — a streamlined alternative to Warhammer 40k that works with any 28-32mm miniatures. The rules fit on a single page, and the game explicitly encourages using 3D printed, proxy, or converted models.

Sci-fi Wargame (Miniature-Agnostic) · 32mm
4 conversions

Fallout: Wasteland Warfare

Modiphius Entertainment
1:50

Fallout: Wasteland Warfare brings the Fallout video game universe to the tabletop with 32mm miniatures covering factions like the Brotherhood of Steel, NCR, Raiders, and Super Mutants. The game supports both PvP and solo/cooperative play against AI-driven encounters.

Post-Apocalyptic Skirmish Wargame · 32mm
4 conversions

Kill Team

Games Workshop
1:50

Kill Team is Games Workshop's sci-fi skirmish game set in the Warhammer 40,000 universe. Instead of massive army battles, you field a small squad of specialists — a sniper, a medic, a heavy weapons trooper — each with unique abilities. The game uses the same 32mm scale as 40k, so every Kill Team model is fully usable in a standard 40k army and vice versa.

Sci-fi Skirmish · 32mm
4 conversions

Necromunda

Games Workshop
1:50

Necromunda is a gang warfare skirmish game set in the underhive of a grimdark megacity, where rival gangs fight for territory, resources, and survival. Each gang — Goliath, Escher, Orlock, Delaque, Cawdor, and Van Saar — has its own playstyle and aesthetic. The game uses the same 32mm scale as Warhammer 40,000, and the industrial terrain is a major part of the experience.

Dystopian Skirmish · 32mm
4 conversions

Warcry

Games Workshop
1:50

Warcry is a fast-paced fantasy skirmish game set in the Age of Sigmar universe, where warbands from the eight realms clash in brutal, quick-resolving combat. Each warband — Ironjawz, Stormcast Eternals, Untamed Beasts, Corvus Cabal, and more — has a distinct visual identity and playstyle. Games are quick, lethal, and packed with cinematic moments.

Fantasy Skirmish · 32mm
4 conversions

35mm Scale

3 systems

Star Wars: Legion

Atomic Mass Games
1:47

Star Wars: Legion is a rank-and-file mass battle game set in the Star Wars universe, covering the Original Trilogy and beyond. Miniatures are measured at 35mm eye level (1:47 scale), making them noticeably larger than Warhammer 40k but smaller than Shatterpoint.

Sci-fi Skirmish Wargame · 35mm
4 conversions

Marvel: Crisis Protocol

Atomic Mass Games
1:48

Marvel: Crisis Protocol pits Marvel superheroes and villains against each other in cinematic tabletop battles. The game uses 35mm true scale with realistic proportions — no heroic exaggeration — making the miniatures notably larger and more detailed than Warhammer-scale equivalents.

Superhero Skirmish Wargame · 35mm
4 conversions

Conquest: Last Argument of Kings

Parabellum Wargames
1:48

Conquest: Last Argument of Kings is a mass-battle fantasy wargame with a unique alternating activation system that keeps both players engaged throughout the game. The setting features the 100 Kingdoms, Nords, Dweghom, and other factions in a grim, low-fantasy world. The game uses 35mm scale, making it slightly larger than Warhammer's 32mm and closer to Star Wars: Legion.

Fantasy Mass Battle · 35mm
4 conversions

40mm Scale

1 system

Star Wars: Shatterpoint

Atomic Mass Games
1:43

Shatterpoint is a squad-based skirmish game where each player commands a small team of named Star Wars characters. The 40mm scale was chosen specifically to capture high-resolution detail while providing large, smooth surfaces ideal for painters practicing blending techniques.

Sci-fi Skirmish Wargame · 40mm
4 conversions

1:27 Scale

1 system

Star Wars: X-Wing

Atomic Mass Games
1:27

Star Wars: X-Wing is a miniatures game of space combat where players pilot iconic Star Wars ships in fast-paced dogfights. The game uses pre-painted plastic ships at 1:27 ratio scale, covering everything from tiny A-Wings to the Millennium Falcon. There are no infantry-scale miniatures — every model is a vehicle or ship.

Sci-fi Dogfight · 1:27
2 conversions

1:56 Scale

1 system

Gaslands

Osprey Games
1:56

Gaslands is a post-apocalyptic vehicular combat game that uses modified Hot Wheels and Matchbox cars as miniatures. At 1:56 scale, these die-cast cars are compatible with 28mm infantry, making it easy to add foot soldiers, terrain, and custom 3D printed accessories.

Post-Apocalyptic Vehicular Combat · 1:56
